loadFailed: Your settings could not be loaded. Close the settings and try again.
saveFailed: The last change could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.secureStorage: Your system's secure storage is not available or access was refused.
errors.io: The file could not be read or written. Check the location and try again.
errors.invalidInput: That did not work: the file or password is not valid.
errors.notFound: The file or item could not be found.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

identity.explanation: Your identity is a certificate stored in your system's secure storage. Servers recognise you by it.
identity.exportHint: Export your identity to a password-protected file and keep it safe. Without it you lose registered names and permissions if this computer breaks.
identity.exportPasswordHint: Choose a password to protect the file. You need it to import the identity again.
identity.importWarning: Importing replaces your current identity. Export it first if you may need it again.

audio.testHint: Speak for a few seconds. Your voice is recorded with noise suppression applied and then played back to you.
audio.musicQualityHint: Uses more bandwidth and turns off noise suppression and automatic volume; for music. Push-to-talk works best.

voice.talkModeLegend: How do you want to talk?
voice.voiceActivation: Voice activation – sends when you speak
voice.pushToTalk: Push-to-talk – sends while you hold a key

unavailable.waylandNoPortal: Push-to-talk is not available: your desktop does not offer global shortcuts.
unavailable.registrationFailed: Push-to-talk is not available: the shortcut could not be registered.
unavailable.mouseDisabled: Push-to-talk is not available: your mouse button needs "Allow mouse buttons" to be switched on.
unavailable.mouseNeedsInputGroup: Push-to-talk is not available: Mumcord may not read your mouse yet (see below).
unavailable.mouseNeedsAccessibility: Push-to-talk is not available: Mumcord needs the Accessibility permission to see mouse buttons.

voice.keyWaiting: Confirm the shortcut in your desktop's dialog or assign it in the System Settings window that opens…
voice.keyMissing: Set a key, otherwise nobody can hear you.
voice.keyRejected: That key cannot be used. Try another key, optionally with Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
voice.keyNotConfirmed: The desktop didn't confirm the shortcut. Try again and accept the system dialog, or assign the key in the desktop's shortcut settings.
voice.noiseSuppressionHint: Filters out background noise like keyboards and fans.
voice.echoCancellationHint: Stops others from hearing themselves when you use speakers.
voice.connectMuted: Connect muted until I join a channel
voice.connectMutedHint: When off, you connect with your last mute and deafen setting right away instead of listening only.
voice.autoGainHint: Keeps your voice at an even level.
voice.keyListeningMouse: Press a key or a mouse button (middle or side)… (Escape to cancel)
voice.mouseToggleWarning: Lets you use a mouse button for push-to-talk. For this you must be in the "input" group, which lets every program you run read all input devices, including your keyboard. Mumcord itself only opens mice, only watches your push-to-talk button and never records or logs anything.
voice.mouseInputGroup: Mumcord may not read your mouse yet. Add yourself to the "input" group by running this command in a terminal:
voice.mouseLogOut: Then log out and back in. Until then, use a keyboard key or voice activation.
voice.mouseNoDevice: No mouse found. Plug one in; Mumcord picks it up automatically.
voice.mouseAccessibility: To use mouse buttons, allow Mumcord under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then restart Mumcord.
voice.compatModeHint: Mumcord runs through your desktop's X11 compatibility layer, like TeamSpeak, so push-to-talk works without a desktop dialog and without the "input" group. Your desktop decides what Mumcord may see: on KDE under System Settings → Legacy X11 App Support. By default only key combinations and modifier keys work; mouse buttons only if you allow them there. This is less isolated than the modern way.
voice.compatRestartNeeded: Takes effect after Mumcord restarts. You will be disconnected briefly.
voice.compatRestartFailed: Mumcord could not restart. Please close and open it yourself.
voice.compatKdeHint: Mouse buttons for push-to-talk only work while Mumcord is in the background if KDE allows them for X11 apps.
voice.compatKdeAllowed: KDE already allows mouse buttons for X11 apps, so the push-to-talk mouse button also works in the background.
voice.compatKdeRestart: Done. Restart Mumcord for it to take effect.
voice.compatKdeConfirm: This lets X11 apps running in the background see your mouse button presses. It changes a setting in KDE (System Settings → Legacy X11 App Support). You can undo it here at any time.
voice.compatKdeChangeFailed: Mumcord could not change the KDE setting. Use "Open KDE X11 settings" instead.
voice.compatKdeFailed: Mumcord could not open the KDE settings. Open System Settings → Legacy X11 App Support yourself.
voice.compatActive: Compatibility mode is on: push-to-talk uses the X11 way. Keys work without a desktop dialog; mouse buttons work if your desktop's legacy X11 setting allows them.
voice.manual: Manual threshold – sends above a level you set
voice.thresholdHint: Drag the slider over the meter. Mumcord sends while the level is above the line, plus a short moment after.

history.explanation: Chat messages are saved only on this computer.
history.confirmServer: All saved messages from {{server}} will be deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.
history.confirmAll: All saved messages from every server will be deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.
history.autoDeleteHint: Older messages are deleted from this computer automatically, without asking. This only affects the history saved here, not the server.

historySharing.title: History sync
historySharing.hint: Other Mumcord users who join or follow a channel can fetch its messages from your saved history (up to 7 days, only from before they joined). Private chats are never shared.

appearance.cozy: Cozy: avatars, names above the messages
appearance.compact: Compact: time, name and message on one line
appearance.closeLegend: When you close the window while connected
appearance.autostart: Start Mumcord when I log in
appearance.startMinimizedHint: When Mumcord starts at login, it waits in the tray instead of opening the window.

accessibility.keyboardHintsHint: Short on-screen tips like “Arrow keys: move” below the channel list and in the GIF favorites. Screen readers still read them when this is off.
accessibility.announcementsHint: Your screen reader reads out events such as people joining, leaving or starting to talk.
accessibility.skipLinksHint: Links at the start of the window that jump straight to the chat or the channel list when you press Tab.

sounds.joinLeave: Someone joins or leaves your channel
sounds.voiceJoin: You join a channel for voice
sounds.messages: New message in a followed channel or private chat

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.explanation: For new messages in your channel, followed channels and private chats, except the chat you are looking at.
notifications.inApp: In-app: a small pop-up inside Mumcord while it is in front
notifications.both: Both: pop-up while Mumcord is in front, system notification otherwise

window.title: Window overlay
window.enableHint: A small transparent window that shows who is talking. Also available from the tray menu.
window.positionUnsupported: This desktop decides where windows appear, so corner positions and moving have no effect.
window.wholeChannelHint: Off: only people who are talking.
window.loadFailed: The overlay options could not be loaded.
window.saveFailed: The overlay change could not be applied.

kwin.done: Done: the KDE window rule “Mumcord overlay” is active.
kwin.removed: The KDE window rule was removed.
kwin.failed: The KDE window rule could not be changed. Open the KDE window rules to add it by hand.

inGame.title: In-game overlay
inGame.explanation: Shows who is talking inside your games. It starts by itself when a game starts and only appears in games.
inGame.antiCheat: Some games with anti-cheat protection treat any overlay as cheating and may ban the account. Those games are off by default, even when this is On.
inGame.noGames: No games known yet. Games show up here once they are detected.
inGame.unsupported: The in-game overlay is not available on this system. The window overlay above is used instead.
inGame.loadFailed: The in-game overlay settings could not be loaded.
inGame.saveFailed: The in-game overlay change could not be applied.
inGame.confirmMessage: Warning: {{game}} uses anti-cheat protection ({{reason}}). Overlays can be detected as cheating and your account may be banned. Mumcord is not responsible for that. Only continue if you accept this risk.

limits.libraryMissing: The in-game overlay is not available: its overlay library (libmumcord_overlay_layer.so) was not found next to Mumcord. Reinstall Mumcord to restore it. The window overlay above is used instead.
limits.windowsPending: The in-game overlay is not available on Windows yet. The window overlay above is used instead.
limits.macos: macOS does not support in-game overlays. The window overlay above is used instead.

diagnostics.fileHint: Saves app version, system, audio devices, connection statistics and recent log lines to a file you can share when reporting a problem. It contains no chat messages, passwords, certificates or personal data.

about.noticesHint: Mumcord is built on open-source software, including code from the Mumble project.
about.noticesFailed: The third-party notices could not be loaded.

profile.title: Profile
profile.sendToNewHint: Sent once, the first time you connect to a server where you have no avatar yet. Never sent again to that server, even if you change or remove your avatar there.
profile.skipped: Your default avatar was not sent: it is too large for this server.

linkPreviews.title: Link previews
linkPreviews.hint: Mumcord loads linked pages to show previews and video players; those sites see your IP address.

nowPlaying.title: Now playing
nowPlaying.hint: Mumcord reads the current track from your system's media player (for example Spotify) – no Spotify login needed. Other Mumcord users see title, artist, cover and progress; official Mumble clients see a "🎵 Artist – Title" line at the end of your comment.
nowPlaying.unsupported: Not supported on macOS: the system offers no way for apps to read the current track.

previewCache.title: Cached previews
previewCache.hint: Link previews, thumbnails and external images are kept on this computer so they load faster. Old ones are removed automatically.

nowGaming.title: Now gaming
nowGaming.hint: Mumcord looks for well-known games among your running programs and for the game Steam is running. Other Mumcord users see the game, its picture and how long you have been playing, and can join your server when the game offers one; official Mumble clients see a "🎮 Game" line at the end of your comment.

positional.title: Positional audio
positional.hint: Voices of people in the same game are placed around you in 3D. Needs a game that shares its positions.
positional.invalid: Enter distances in metres: minimum at least 0, maximum at least 1 above the minimum and at most 1000.

gamePlugins.title: Positional audio: sources
gamePlugins.explanation: Games tell Mumcord where you are through Mumble Link or through official Mumble game plugins. Mumcord finds the plugins in its own plugin folder and in an existing Mumble installation. Turn on only the plugins for games you play.
gamePlugins.antiCheat: Game plugins read the game's memory. Some anti-cheat systems may flag this; turn plugins off for games with strict anti-cheat.
gamePlugins.nothing: No game is delivering positions right now.
gamePlugins.none: No game plugins found. Install Mumble or copy plugin files into Mumcord's plugin folder.
gamePlugins.loadFailed: The game plugins could not be listed.
gamePlugins.switchFailed: The game plugin could not be switched.

problem.failed: Stopped after an error. Turn it off and on again to retry.
